summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** ** Petition No. 512/TD/2024 ** # **Coram:** **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** **Date of Order: 28** **th** **August, 2025** # **In the matter of** Application under Section 14 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 6 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of trading licence and other related matters) Regulations, 2020 for grant of an InterState Trading Licence. # **And In the matter of** # **Greennsure Power Private Limited,** No. 34, 30A, 1 st Floor, Swathi Complex, Venkatanarayana Road, Nandanam, Chennai – 600035. ** Applicant** # ** ORDER ** The Petitioner, Greennsure Power Private Limited, has filed the present Application for the grant of an Inter-State Trading Licence. 2. The Petitioner, vide its affidavit dated 4.7.2025, has sought permission to withdraw the instant Application and liberty to approach the Commission at a subsequent stage. 3. The Petition is being decided by circulation. 4. Considering the submissions made by the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 4.7.2025, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw the instant Application. Order in Petition No. 512/TD/2024 Page 1 5. Accordingly, Petition No. 512/TD/2024 is disposed of as withdrawn. **Sd/sd/sd/sd/(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson** Order in Petition No. 512/TD/2024 Page 2 CERC Website S. No. 537/2025
